name: loop-closer
description: Loop Closer: every open loop in your head, out and closed by tonight. Turn a brain dump into a swipeable, game-like task deck for one day.

plugins.name: loop-closer
plugins.description: Dump everything on your mind; Claude sizes each item, writes a 2-minute first move for it, sequences quick wins before the big scary thing, and ships a one-page app with XP, timers, random tickets, and a cash-out recap.
